summary.zh: 研發製造原子層沉積與真空鍍膜設備，服務半導體先進製程。
summary.en: Develops atomic-layer-deposition and vacuum-coating equipment for advanced semiconductor processes.

overview.zh: 原子精製股份有限公司位於台南，登記營業項目涵蓋原子層沉積（ALD）設備及零組件、真空鍍膜系統的研發、生產與銷售。公司鎖定半導體與先進製程的薄膜沉積與表面處理應用，屬深度科技裝置製造商。
overview.en: Based in Tainan, Atomic Refining develops, manufactures and sells atomic-layer-deposition (ALD) equipment, components and vacuum-coating systems. It targets thin-film deposition and surface-treatment applications for semiconductor and advanced manufacturing, positioning itself as a deep-tech equipment maker.

summary.zh: 打造AI×BIM平台，以生成式AI加速建築前期設計與法規檢核。
summary.en: Builds an AI x BIM platform that accelerates early-stage architectural design and code compliance with generative AI.

overview.zh: 築智科技（SparkGen）源自東海大學價創計畫，致力於打造台灣首屈一指的AI×BIM建築設計平台。其推出巧達匠（深度學習量體生成）、算容匠（智慧容積與AI法規檢核）、模估匠（AI成本預估）等工具，解決建築設計週期長、知識傳承不易等痛點。
overview.en: Spun out of Tunghai University's value-creation program, SparkGen builds an AI x BIM platform for architecture. Its tools generate building massing via deep learning, run smart volume and AI-assisted regulatory checks, and predict construction costs, addressing long design cycles and knowledge-transfer pain points in the architecture industry.

summary.zh: 親子天下旗下公司，為3-12歲孩童打造寓教於樂的數位影音內容。
summary.en: A Parenting (CommonWealth) subsidiary delivering edutainment digital audio-video content for children aged 3-12.

overview.zh: 親子學股份有限公司成立於2023年，為親子天下集團旗下公司，由何琦瑜擔任負責人。公司專注於為華語區3-12歲兒童打造高品質、寓教於樂的影音內容，提供Podcast、有聲書、線上課程與學習平台等數位學習產品。
overview.en: Founded in 2023 as a subsidiary of the Parenting (CommonWealth) group and led by Chyi-Yu Ho, Parenting Learning creates high-quality edutainment audio-video content for Chinese-speaking children aged 3-12, offering podcasts, audiobooks, online courses and learning platforms.

summary.zh: 經營「媽爹講故事」品牌，為孩童製作有聲故事App與Podcast。
summary.en: Runs the Mom&Dad Story brand, producing children's audio-story apps and podcasts.

overview.zh: 小耳朵文化傳媒股份有限公司成立於2021年，由「華爸&鳥媽」（曾為歌手與YouTuber，知名為Mom&Dad）創立。公司營運「媽爹講故事」有聲故事App與Podcast頻道，為不同成長階段的孩子打造高品質且具娛樂性的故事內容，屬文化創意與電子商務領域。
overview.en: Founded in 2021 by the couple behind the Mom&Dad brand (former singers and YouTubers), Little Ears Cultural Media operates the Mom&Dad Story audio-story app and podcast channel, producing high-quality, entertaining stories for children across developmental stages in the cultural-content and e-commerce space.

summary.zh: 從事農牧服務與生物相關製品，發展永續導向的農業應用。
summary.en: Provides agricultural and livestock services and bio-derived products for sustainability-oriented farming applications.

overview.zh: 格雷迪奧股份有限公司成立於2022年，位於台中，登記營業項目包含其他農事及畜牧服務、化粧品製造、化學原材料批發與專業科學技術服務，並曾參展臺灣智慧農業週。研判其聚焦於農牧與生物相關製品的智慧農業應用，呼應綠色永續主題。
overview.en: Founded in 2022 in Taichung, Gredio is registered for agricultural and livestock services, cosmetics manufacturing, chemical-materials wholesale and scientific-technical services, and has exhibited at Taiwan Smart Agriweek. It appears focused on agri/livestock and bio-derived products for smart, sustainability-oriented farming.

summary.zh: 以AI驅動的HolonOS讓工業機械手臂部署像下載App一樣快速直覺。
summary.en: Its AI-driven HolonOS makes deploying industrial robot arms as fast and intuitive as installing an app.

overview.zh: 赫侖股份有限公司成立於2025年，為工研院衍生新創，位於新竹縣，創辦人羅元玠出身台大應力所與工研院。其HolonOS結合多功能感測器、工業機器人整合與AI數據分析，將技師經驗數位化並自動規劃手臂路徑，協助傳產工廠快速、低成本邁向自動化。
overview.en: Founded in 2025 in Hsinchu as an ITRI spin-off, Holon Robotics was started by Yuan-Chieh Lo. Its HolonOS combines multi-function sensors, industrial-robot integration and AI data analysis to digitize technicians' know-how and auto-plan robot-arm paths, helping traditional factories automate quickly and at low cost.

summary.zh: 彰化在地旅行社，提供國內外旅遊行程與相關旅遊服務。
summary.en: A Changhua-based travel agency offering domestic and outbound tours and related travel services.

overview.zh: 積木旅遊旅行社股份有限公司成立於2021年，位於彰化縣永靖鄉，負責人為黃韋典，已於交通部觀光署登記為合法旅行社。公司提供旅遊行程規劃與旅遊服務，屬消費生活旅遊領域的新創旅行社。
overview.en: Founded in 2021 in Yongjing, Changhua, and led by Wei-Tien Huang, Bricks Travel Inc. is a licensed travel agency registered with Taiwan's Tourism Administration. It provides tour planning and travel services as a startup travel agency in the consumer-lifestyle sector.

summary.zh: 提供微電網一站式服務，整合儲能、充電與氫能能源解決方案。
summary.en: Provides one-stop microgrid services integrating energy storage, EV charging and hydrogen solutions.

overview.zh: 台灣微網科技股份有限公司成立於2023年，核心團隊來自中興電工與台達電子，深耕微電網領域逾十年。公司提供自規劃設計、系統整合到建置維運的微電網一站式服務，主力包含儲能、充電站與氫燃料電池（含綠氫微電網）解決方案。2025年入選國發會「創業大聯盟」前300強並獲Garage+選為能源領域MustSee Startup。
overview.en: Founded in 2023, Taiwan Microgrid Technology was started by a team from Chung-Hsin Electric and Delta Electronics with over a decade in microgrids. It offers one-stop microgrid services from design and system integration to construction and O&M, focused on energy storage, EV-charging and hydrogen fuel-cell (including green-hydrogen microgrid) solutions. In 2025 it was named a top-300 team in the NDC Startup Alliance competition and a Garage+ MustSee energy startup.

summary.zh: 台灣首家自主生產核多角體病毒生物農藥的農業生技公司。
summary.en: Taiwan's first agri-biotech firm independently producing baculovirus (NPV) biopesticides.

overview.zh: 樸農生技股份有限公司成立於2020年，位於屏東縣長治鄉，負責人為林弘人。公司是台灣首家能自主生產核多角體病毒（NPV）作為生物農藥的農業生技公司，針對甜菜夜蛾、斜紋夜蛾等鱗翅目害蟲開發病毒製劑，並建置生物防治資材量產系統與應用服務，呼應友善環境的永續農業。
overview.en: Founded in 2020 in Changzhi, Pingtung, and led by Hung-Jen Lin, PuNong Biotech is Taiwan's first agri-biotech company to independently produce nucleopolyhedrovirus (NPV) as a biopesticide. It develops viral formulations against lepidopteran pests such as beet and Oriental armyworm and builds mass-production systems and application services for biological control, supporting eco-friendly sustainable agriculture.
